method: Current in-app Browser layout inspection at the exact production screenshot viewports, plus the 795px breakpoint.

assertions.evidence: The 1432px desktop capture fits the page viewport; dense schedule content remains inside its table and rail grid.
At 382px the page overflow measurement was 0px; navigation and filter rows use contained horizontal scrollers.
At 795px page overflow remained 0px and the schedule sheet switched to its single-flow layout.
